_nota: NeonGrid texts (en). Same keys as es.json; comprobar.py checks it.
consejos.defecto: Commit often: small changes, clear history.
Back up your files. And check that you can restore them.
Close what you are not using: your RAM will thank you.
Stand up and stretch every hour.
Rest your eyes: look at something far away for 20 seconds.
Update calmly, not in the middle of a deadline.
One task at a time beats five half-done.
Write down the next step before you stop: tomorrow you will be grateful.
Long, unique passwords. A manager remembers them for you.
When something fails, read the whole error message.
Restart now and then: it fixes more than you think.
Take short breaks: 25 minutes of focus, 5 of rest.
Mind your posture: straight back, screen at eye level.
Write your ideas down: memory is a poor secretary.
Delete what you no longer use: tidiness is speed too.
